shared_or_similar_visual_information: A boundary or edge drawn with broken strokes in a three-dimensional solid view.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents a hidden rear edge of the three-dimensional solid. Right image: They represent rear edges of the folded three-dimensional bowl that are hidden from view.
Rationales: Both selected broken lines belong to the rear, occluded part of the depicted solid. They use the hidden-edge convention, even when one boundary is curved or one drawing uses dots rather than longer dashes.
